[[File:IGmultisensorHeadIncom.jpg|thumb|The Incom IG-series Multisensor Head]]
'''[[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] Multisensor Heads''' were head parts for [[Droid/Legends|droids]], made by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]]. They were designed to be [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol]]-style heads with wide-angle [[Photoreceptor/Legends|visual sensors]] and [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot]] [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]]. Constructed from [[Copper/Legends|copper]], [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] and ferritic stainless [[Steel/Legends|steel]], these parts could not be magnetized. The heads had high material durability.

These components were part of the infamous [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droid]] model, and possibly some of its [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|predecessors]].

==Behind the scenes==
It should be noted the IG-series as a whole displayed a lot of different droid heads (from the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] to the [[IG-97 battle droid|IG-97]]). This seems to indicate the Incom IG-series Multisensor Head was used with the IG-88 model only.
